description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the case where the user has NOT named a roadmap and wants one chosen and shipped: pick the next sensible/executable roadmap, screen what is actually startable, and carry it to a PR. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours that each own a different surface: /roadmap:process-full and /roadmap:process-phase (a roadmap is NAMED, so nothing is selected — scope only), /roadmap:create (authoring a new roadmap from a stated request), /roadmap:ai-council (challenging one named roadmap, no execution), and a plain read-only status question about the roadmap dashboard.
